Promote BIC culture, business priorities, and best practices across distributor organizations. Lead customer development initiatives and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic accounts. Ensure effective implementation of commercial and marketing plans in close collaboration with Regional Sales, Marketing, and Trade Marketing teams. Monitor In-Market Sales (IMS), distribution, and execution KPIs to identify opportunities and drive corrective actions. Support the assessment and development of new route-to-market options, distribution partners, and expansion opportunities. Build and maintain an annual commercial activation calendar aligned with business objectives and market opportunities.
